scripts.dev: concurrently "(cd backend-rs && cargo run --bin portfolio-api)" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.build: (cd backend-rs && cargo build --release) && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.lint: (cd backend-rs && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings) && pnpm --filter @portfolio/core-view build:verify && pnpm --filter frontend lint && pnpm --filter mobile lint
scripts.start: pnpm run docker:up && pnpm run docker:logs
scripts.test: (cd backend-rs && cargo test --workspace) && pnpm --filter @portfolio/core-view test && pnpm --filter frontend test:unit && pnpm --filter mobile test:e2e
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run test:coverage:backend && pnpm run test:coverage:core-view && pnpm run test:coverage:frontend && pnpm run test:coverage:mobile
